messages.text: Can I connect the magic miner via WiFi

Yes. The 40T has dual-band Wi-Fi, 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz, plus an RJ45 Ethernet port if you'd rather wire it. You set the network on first boot from its own setup page, then it runs headless.

Honest tip for a 24/7 miner: if the router is reachable with a cable, use Ethernet. Wi-Fi works fine, but a dropped link means lost shares until it reconnects.
